categories_review.source: README Supported devices and production drivers support CoolLED/iLed/iPixel matrix LED displays for visual text and image media. The official Core taxonomy snapshot ec18d8b25d1ee39aa8b85a72a170e42bee33228c provides media_entertainment as the actual display product purpose; these are not general lighting bulbs.

readme.title: BLE LED Sign for Home Assistant

descriptions.en: A Home Assistant custom integration that controls CoolLED, iLed and iPixel Color Bluetooth matrix LED displays, automating scrolling text, static messages, graphics and dynamic layouts.
descriptions.ko: CoolLED, iLed, iPixel Color Bluetooth 매트릭스 LED 전광판의 스크롤 텍스트·상태 메시지·그래픽·동적 레이아웃을 자동화하는 Home Assistant 커스텀 통합입니다.
